summary: Verified auto-locale detection on public landing '/' via Playwright with navigator override injected before page scripts. All 4 scenarios PASSED: (1) German browser (new visitor) auto-switches to DE hero + localStorage lang='de'; (2) explicit saved 'en' beats German browser locale; (3) French browser auto-switches to FR hero + localStorage lang='fr'; (4) English browser stays English.

detailed_results.expected: hero contains 'Acceptez les paiements crypto.' & lang=='fr'

context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n auto-detect works correctly on '/'. Priority chain (?lang= > saved localStorage 'lang' > navigator locale for new visitors > English default) is functioning. Note: English browsers with no saved pref end up with localStorage.lang='en' after hydration (implementation persists 'en' even for English browsers) — this does not violate the spec (still English hero) but worth noting.
